titolo: What If Every Car on Earth Stopped Working Tomorrow?

scene.testo: Tomorrow morning, every car on Earth stops working.
Not one engine starts. Not one.
There are over one billion cars on the planet.
Within hours, entire cities would be gridlocked.
Ambulances stuck. Buses stranded. Delivery trucks frozen on the road.
Grocery stores keep only a few days of fresh food.
And trucks bring almost all of it.
But that's not the strangest part.
The biggest change would be how quickly the world shrinks.
Here is what happens, hour by hour, step by step.
